To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new SpltNPV isolate from Pakistan was characterized and found to be a genuine SpltNVP isolate.

we have isolated a new SpltNPV isolate from S. litura larvae collected from the field, characterized it biologically and genetically and found it to be different from a reference isolate, S. litura-G1, that was previously used as a SpltNPVs reference isolate.

the SpltNPVs SpltNPV- Pak-BNG and SpliNPV- G1 are different viruses, that SpliNPV is a more virulent isolate than SpltNPV, and that Splt NPV-Pak-BN is a genuine S. litura NPV variant, whereas SpltNPV -G1 is a SpliNP V variant.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the characterization of an indigenous Pakistani isolate of SpltNPVs, which may have a potential for the development as a bio-control agent of S. littoralia in Pakistan and elsewhere in South Asia.
the characterization of a novel SpltNPV isolate from Pakistan and its comparison to a reference isolate from China.
the characterization of the first Pakistani isolate of SpltNP V, and the re-identification of SpltNPVG1 as a SpliNP V isolate.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
SpltNPVs from Pakistan and China are different viruses, but the two viruses have similar pathogenicity in their respective host.
this is the first report of a SpltNPv isolate from Pakistan.
the Pakistani isolate is an S. litura NPV isolate (SpltNPVs) and the Chinese isolate is an S.littoralis NPV isolate (SpliNPV), but the two isolates are not genetically related.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the SpltNPVs isolated from different countries have different genetic and biological properties, and the use of SpltNPVs from one country for the control of Spodoptera spp. in other countries may have limited success.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of a reference isolate of an insect NPV for the development of a biocontrol product may be inappropriate, and the isolate used should instead be a representative of the local NPV variant.
